Strategy: Strong scaled wide dual dead-zone avoidance. Exact fits score highest; tiny residuals below a quarter of the item and awkward residuals between a third and the full item lose the full item, while others rank like Best Fit. The choice differs from Best Fit when the tightest fit falls in either zone while a looser bin avoids both. It may help by firmly avoiding unusable leftovers, but may fail if it pushes items into roomy bins too often.

```python
def priority(item, bins):
    return [1000.0 if r - item == 0 else (-(r - item) - item if (r - item < item / 4 or (r - item > item / 3 and r - item <= item)) else -(r - item)) for r in bins]
```
generator_note: Strong scaled wide dual dead-zone avoidance: penalize residual < item/4 and residual in (item/3, item] by item.
